integrity: The uniform upper bound is explicitly attributed to Xie; the sharp lower bounds are proved by an algebraically injective coefficient family. Computations cover finitely many lengths and do not establish the unrestricted formula.
scientific_limitations: Only the complex four-column, three-dimensional zero fiber is addressed; dimensions, not irreducible-component schemes; the general odd-length case and characteristic p remain open. Full-text comparison with Casabella–Sammartano was unavailable; independent validation was not performed.
title: Exact dimensions of every jet scheme of four orthogonal vectors in three dimensions
